introHtml: Custom 12 oz diner restaurant mugs offer the classic diner feel in a versatile size that holds the perfect amount of coffee or tea. Whether you're outfitting a retro-style eatery or creating branded merchandise for customers, this capacity is a customer favorite. Many 12 oz options feature vacuum insulation to keep drinks hot, and they provide ample surface area for full-color logo decoration. Choose from ceramic or stainless steel constructions to match your brand's aesthetic.
